# Visible Ads: Award-Winning PPC & SEM Consultancy

> Visible Ads is a boutique search engine marketing consultancy based in Kingston-Upon-Thames, UK. We specialise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Advertising, Paid Social, eCRO, and SEO for businesses generating £1M+ revenue.

- Google Ads Management (our flagship service): /google-ads

- Paid Social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok): /paid-social
- Amazon Advertising: /amazon
- eCommerce Conversion Rate Optimisation (eCRO): /ecro
- SEO: /seo

## Key Results
- £6.7M return from £555K Google Ads spend for CFW (12x ROAS)
- £2.31M ad-driven revenue for Sephra Europe
- 450% sales growth for iWholesales
- 12x lead volume for Luxury Architecture firm

## White-Label / Agency Partnerships
Visible Ads delivers white-label PPC, paid social and SEO for agencies reselling to their own clients. White-label delivery starts from £500 per month per client account; the agency keeps the client relationship.: /ppc-for-professional-services

## Free Tools
All free, no login and no email required. Every calculation runs in the visitor's browser.
- Tools hub: /tools
- PPC Budget Calculator (/tools/ppc-budget-calculator): turns a monthly budget into forecast impressions, clicks, leads or sales, then checks the plan against gross margin and break-even ROAS. Industry benchmarks are LocaliQ's published averages and every assumption is editable.
- Ad Test Significance Calculator (/tools/ad-test-significance): judges a running A/B ad test with a two-proportion test, or sizes a new test from daily budget, CPC and the smallest lift worth acting on. Works with Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Ads and TikTok data.
- Media Planner (/tools/media-planner): splits a monthly budget across thirteen channels from a funnel split, returning CPM, impressions, clicks and CPC per channel, with CSV export.
- Weather-Based Bidding Tool (/tools/weather-bidding): turns a seven-day UK forecast into daily budget, bid and seasonality adjustments for weather-sensitive categories, with separate advice for Smart Bidding and manual bidding. Forecast data from MET Norway under CC BY 4.0.
- ROAS vs Profit Calculator (/roas-vs-profit): whether a given ROAS is profitable once product margin is included.
- Break-even ROAS by Margin (/blog/break-even-roas): the ROAS needed to break even at every margin from 20% to 60%.
- Golden Quarter Tactics (/tools/golden-quarter-tactics): four downloadable peak-season guides (Google Ads, Amazon, Meta Ads, SEO). These require a confirmed email address; the calculators above do not.
